sfx.name: ui_tap
sfx.text: loud crisp UI button click, a single dry tick, close microphone, sharp attack, no reverb, no music, no voice

sfx.name: ui_back
sfx.text: loud close-mic rustle of one paper sheet lifted off a desk, short and clear, dry, no reverb, no music, no voice

sfx.name: ui_deny
sfx.text: one muted dry paper tick, dull and very short, soft, no buzzer, no error beep, no reverb, no music, no voice
sfx.notes: 点了不能放的格子、灰按钮

sfx.name: stamp
sfx.text: loud close-mic thud of a stone seal pressed once onto thick paper, full short impact then a crisp paper edge, dry, no reverb, no music, no voice

sfx.name: chime
sfx.text: loud close-mic strike of two small ceramic bowls, a lower ping then a higher ping, each ping clearly audible, dry room, no music, no voice

sfx.name: draft
sfx.text: three paper cards fanned open on a desk, soft paper rustle, short, dry and close, no reverb, no music, no voice

sfx.name: shot
sfx.text: one short wet calligraphy brush flick, soft bristle whoosh, light and airy, quick decay, dry and close, no gunshot, no explosion, no reverb, no music, no voice
sfx.notes: 发弹。时长压短，连射才不糊

sfx.name: hit
sfx.text: loud bubble pop, one fat soap bubble bursting close to the microphone, round low body, dry, no music, no voice
sfx.notes: 默认命中，解压的核心音

sfx.name: hit_thud
sfx.text: punchy low thump of a fist hitting a firm cushion, short tight body with a quick click on the attack, close microphone, dry, no reverb, no music, no voice
sfx.notes: 垫在每一下命中底下的低频身体

sfx.name: kill_pop
sfx.text: loud satisfying pop of a big bubble wrap bubble bursting close to the microphone, crisp snap then a tiny airy puff, dry, no music, no voice
sfx.notes: 小怪死亡的清脆一下，音高随连杀往上走

sfx.name: hit_fire
sfx.text: a dry paper snap followed by one tiny charcoal crackle, sharp attack, very short decay, close and dry, no roaring fire, no explosion, no reverb, no music, no voice

sfx.name: hit_ice
sfx.text: a thin porcelain chip tick, bright and glassy, one note, sharp attack, very short decay, dry and close, no wind, no reverb, no music, no voice

sfx.name: boom
sfx.text: a loud wet ink splash with a low thump underneath, the body lasts about a third of a second, close microphone, dry room, no debris, no music, no voice

sfx.name: kill
sfx.text: wet ink blooming into rice paper then a soft falling brush release, round and gentle, short, dry room, no scream, no music, no voice

sfx.name: boss
sfx.text: a heavy wet ink splash on a desk, then a slow low brush stroke that keeps sounding, the whole gesture lasts about one second, close and weighty, short room, loud, no orchestra, no music, no voice

sfx.name: leak
sfx.text: a soft thick paper tear, low and round, brief, sad but not an alarm, dry and close, no siren, no buzzer, no music, no voice

sfx.name: pickup
sfx.text: loud woodblock hit, one bright strike, close microphone, short and clear, dry, no music, no voice

sfx.name: spell
sfx.text: one broad wet brush stroke across rice paper, audible soft bristles, a gentle swell and a clean release, dry and close, no magic choir, no reverb tail, no music, no voice
sfx.notes: 放技能。音高在代码里按技能微调

sfx.name: win
sfx.text: three soft pentatonic ceramic notes rising slowly, small and warm, like a guqin harmonic, gentle ending, no drums, no orchestra, no voice, no lyrics

sfx.name: lose
sfx.text: two clear descending tones on a soft low flute, each note close and plainly audible, gentle but present, no buzzer, no voice, no drums

sfx.name: res_star
sfx.text: loud close-mic thud of a heavy brass seal slammed onto a wooden desk, followed by one bright ceramic bell ping that keeps ringing clearly for half a second, sharp attack, dry room, no music, no voice
sfx.notes: 结算星星砸进星座。三颗逐颗升调在代码里做

sfx.name: res_confetti
sfx.text: a paper party popper bursting open close to the microphone, then a quick shower of light paper flakes rustling down, bright and cheerful, dry, no music, no voice, no crowd

sfx.name: res_tick
sfx.text: one tiny bright coin tick, a small copper coin tapped once on porcelain, sharp attack, very short, dry, no reverb, no music, no voice
sfx.notes: 奖励数字滚动，会高频重复

sfx.name: res_heart
sfx.text: one deep double heartbeat thump, lub-dub, low and round, close and tight, dry, no music, no voice
sfx.notes: 续命页心跳，倒计时越后越快

sfx.name: res_crumble
sfx.text: a heavy wooden cannon cracking and falling onto a stone floor, a loud crack then a short rumble of wood pieces settling, close microphone, short room, no explosion, no music, no voice
sfx.notes: 失败动画炮台砸地歪倒

sfx.name: res_unlock
sfx.text: a bright rising shimmer of small ceramic chimes ending on one clear high bell note, sparkling and hopeful, short tail, dry room, no orchestra, no music, no voice

sfx.name: cell_drop
sfx.text: loud punchy pop of a soft rubber toy block dropped onto a wooden table, round bouncy thump with a tiny bright click on top, close microphone, dry, no reverb, no music, no voice
sfx.notes: 字落空格：软胶积木落桌

sfx.name: cell_upgrade
sfx.text: bright cheerful three-note rising toy xylophone run, quick and clear, each note ringing, ending in a tiny glittery sparkle, close and dry, no music bed, no voice
sfx.notes: 同字升星，音高按星级往上推

sfx.name: cell_swap
sfx.text: quick cartoon swish of a card flicked away, then immediately a soft bouncy rubber toy block thump, close microphone, dry, no reverb, no music, no voice
sfx.notes: 异字替换：旧字甩走、新字落下

sfx.name: word_form
sfx.text: loud cheerful mobile game combo power-up, four bright bell notes rising quickly, then a long warm sparkling shimmer that rings out and slowly fades, clear and joyful, short room, no voice

sfx.name: word_break
sfx.text: loud cartoon descending slide whistle, short falling pitch then a soft muted wooden plonk, close microphone, dry, no music, no voice

sfx.name: charge_fire
sfx.text: short bright energy release, a quick rising rubbery pluck with a tiny sparkle on top, light and snappy, close and dry, no gunshot, no explosion, no reverb, no music, no voice
sfx.notes: 蓄力字蓄满，这一发带上效果

sfx.name: battle_start
sfx.text: two quick soft wooden toy drum taps followed by a bright cheerful rising marimba run of three notes ending on a little sparkle, playful and light, close and dry, no brass, no orchestra, no voice
